title: Cahn behind Flater's complaint

tellings.quote: cuz it was Khan that contacted Flater.

plain: In Denver in 1953, according to a researcher named Scott Ramsey, a man named JP Khan was the one who contacted a man named Herman Flader, which in Ramsey's view puts Khan behind a complaint Flader made, a matter that also touches J. Edgar Hoover, then head of the FBI. Ramsey, who studies a reported saucer crash said to have held sixteen alien bodies, offers this to Michels as his own reading without naming a source, because if true it would mean the complaint was steered by someone else.
